title: FHFA House Price Index — Monthly Index (October 2026 data)
source: EST: fhfa.gov/data/hpi fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes), "2026 HPI Release Dates" table, row "Tuesday, December 29 | Monthly Index | October 2026" — the same forward table that carries this proposer's own date, and corroborated by the published 2026Q2 report's release-date appendix (pages 26-27). Filed estimate because the proposal contract forbids a proposer filing any event as confirmed (docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md), not because the primary is weak. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24 initial research (2026-09-06), proposed for two reasons this calendar can act on. First, it is the print that SCORES that ledger's revision forward test: the December monthly report restates September 2026 one step, and 104 of 105 published one-step revisions in FHFA's own "(Previous Estimate)" tables moved the m/m by 0.1pp or less. Second, and the reason it is not just bookkeeping: cr-expiry-2026-12-11 sits eighteen days ahead of it, and FHFA is the calendar's one publisher a funding lapse cannot stop — 12 U.S.C. 4516(f)(2)-(3) declares its assessment income "not ... Government or public funds or appropriated money" and exempts it from apportionment, and 222 of 222 months since March 2008 carry a release, including two inside the 2018-19 shutdown. In a lapse branch this becomes one of the few housing reads still arriving, which is the same argument the tracked consumer-confidence-2026-10-27 entry makes for a private publisher. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
